plain_text:
DRAFT 
COMMUNITY PRESERVATION COMMITTEE 
 MINUTES 
October 13, 2026 
  
A regular meeting of the Community Preservation Committee (CPC) was held on Tuesday, October 13, 
2026 at 6:00 pm via remote participation through Zoom.  Present were Bob Callahan (Acting Chair), 
Rebecca English, Aaron Paternoster, Jeremy Mele and Tom Furey. Also present was Patti Kelleher of the 
City of Salem Department of Planning & Community Development. Not present: Bart Hoskins (Chair), 
Megan Montgomery, and Annie Thompson. 
 
 
Public Hearing and Comment 
 
Ms. Kelleher stated that the purpose of this public hearing is to solicit input regarding the development of 
this year’s Community Preservation Plan (for FY27). The Plan will be used to guide the Community 
Preservation Committee’s decision-making when reviewing and recommending project applications for 
Community Preservation Act funding. 
 
Ms. Kelleher provided a PowerPoint presentation overview of the CPA. 
 
Mr. Callahan opened up the public hearing to questions and comments. 
 
Mr. Callahan asked for more information on restrictions for historic preservation awards. Ms. Kelleher 
provided information on the requirement for non-profits to enter into a preservation restriction to ensure 
public benefit. The restriction is in perpetuity. Mr. Callahan noted that Boston only requires a restriction 
for 10 years. Ms. Kelleher stated that she could explore this further. 
 
Mr. Paternoster asked whether award funding has mechanism to require adherence to wage theft 
ordinance. Ms. Kelleher agreed to research this further and would look for opportunity to include 
language relating to this ordinance in the CPA Annual Plan.  
 
Susan Tweed from Grace Church was present at the meeting. She asked if the CPA program provided 
funds only on a reimbursement process. Ms. Kelleher replied that the CPA grant agreements allowed 
some limited flexibility, but CPA funds typically are distributed after an applicant provided 
documentation that an invoice had been paid.  
 
 
Review and Vote on Determination of Eligibility Applications received  
 
Ms. Kelleher reported that no applications for eligibility determination have been received. 
 
 
Review and Vote on Proposed Revisions to Eligibility Applications and Full Applications 
 
Mr. Callahan suggested adding language to the application form regarding adherence to wage theft 
ordinance. 
 
Ms. Kelleher asked the Committee if they still preferred to receive applications in paper format. All 
agreed that applications should be submitted in paper form but eligibility applications could be submitted

electrically. Ms. Kelleher will revise eligibility application to remove requirement for paper copies. The 
Committee agreed to postpone vote on full application to the next meeting when more membes are 
present.  
 
VOTE: Ms. English made a motion to approve the FY27 eligibility application form. Mr. Furey 
seconded the motion. All were in favor and the motion so passed. 
 
Other Business: 
 
Approval of meeting minutes of May 15, 2026. 
 
VOTE: Ms. English made a motion to accept the minutes of May 15, 2026. Mr. Mele seconded the 
motion. All were in favor and the motion so passed. 
 
Member reports on solicitation of comments from City boards/commissions 
Ms. Kelleher noted that no letters have been received from City boards and committees. Members noted 
that their respective boards have CPA comment on upcoming meetings. 
 
Funding Availability Update 
Ms. Kelleher reported that funding availability for the next funding round has not yet been reported. The 
Committee agreed to continue this to the following meeting.  
 
Discussion/Election of Chair and Vice Chair 
The Committee agreed to continue this discussion to the next meeting.  
 
 
Next meeting date  
 
Mr. Callahan noted that the next meeting is Tuesday, November 11, 6:00pm.  
 
 
There being no further business, Mr. Mele made a motion to adjourn at 6:40pm. Ms. English seconded the 
motion; all were in favor, and the motion so carried. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
Patti Kelleher 
CPA Administrator
